title: Flags after a subtraction
description:
Work out the flags `cmp` sets, and which conditional jumps would be taken.

```
cmp 5, 7 (8-bit): result 0xFE  ZF 0 SF 1 CF 1 OF 0
  jb taken (unsigned 5 < 7), jl taken (signed 5 < 7)
cmp 0x80, 1: result 0x7F  ZF 0 SF 0 CF 0 OF 1
  jb not taken (128 > 1), jl taken (-128 < 1)
```
hints: CF is the borrow (`a < b` unsigned); OF is set when `a` and `b` have different signs and the result's sign differs from `a`'s (lesson 7.04).
requirements: Compute `a - b` on 8-bit values and set ZF, SF, CF and OF from the definitions.
Decide `je`, `jb`, `ja`, `jl`, `jg` from the flags only, not from `a` and `b`.
Show a case where the signed and unsigned answers differ.
stretch: Do the same for `add`, and compare with the existing build task on flags.
